$comment: THE LIST OF THINGS YOUR CHILD MAY OPEN.
Every entry below ships with "enabled": false on purpose. Sukhi Play does
not choose destinations for you and does not endorse any site. You decide
where it may go, and you are responsible for complying with each site's
terms of service. Please read DISCLAIMER.md.
TO TURN SOMETHING ON: set "enabled": true, then restart the app.
TO CHECK IT WORKS:   npm run check -- --check=<id>
The entries below are examples. Their allowHosts lists are a starting point,
not a guarantee - run the check above and add whatever host it reports.
id           unique short name, no spaces
shape        star | rocket | ball | blocks | note | leaf | drop | bolt
allowHosts   ONLY these hosts may load anything. Everything else is cut.
denyHosts    overrides allowHosts, for ad subdomains of an allowed domain
enabled      true to show the tile
